title: WIFCOIN — claimEarned() burnRate Repeated-Call Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: `claimEarned(uint256 burnRate)` can be called repeatedly with the same burnRate=10 until the reward balance is exhausted; staking state is not invalidated after withdrawal, so residual rewards are continuously paid out on every call
code_before:
❌ No call-interval restriction — repeated calls possible
        //
steps: earnedRewards recalculation bug → rewards re-issued on every call
→ [4] Remaining WIF → ETH reverse swap (Uniswap V2)
→ [5] Net profit ~3.4 ETH (vs. initial 0.3 ETH investment)
other_code:

  │         └─ stakedBalance[attacker] = wifBal

  ├─→ [3] claimEarned(10) repeated calls (until revert)
